## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits: `type: summary`, for example `fix(page): keep the sidebar open`
- [ ] Every commit is signed off with `git commit -s`
- [ ] A test failed first and now passes
- [ ] `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` and `node tests/page/run.js` pass
- [ ] The pull request is linked to an issue above, unless it is a typo fix
- [ ] No code comments, neutral examples only, no secrets
